name: meta_audience_network-mcp
description: Meta Audience Network (ads): me, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_meta_audience_network_acces.title: PLATFORM_MCP_META_AUDIENCE_NETWORK_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_meta_audience_network_acces.description: Long-lived Meta User Access Token with the read_audience_network_insights permission (system user tokens are not supported by this endpoint); long-lived user tokens last about 60 days and must then be renewed.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /me: the user the token belongs to ({id, name}).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /{account_id}/adnetworkanalytics (account_id = the Business, property or app id) with metrics fb_ad_network_request, _imp, _click, _revenue, aggregation_period=day, since/until: one row per metric per day (value is a string; revenue in the account currency). Synchronous queries cover at most 8 days and 2,000 rows; data is kept 540 days. Audience Network is a publisher (monetisation) product; `campaign_id` does not apply.
